# clippy settings

Every `clippy.toml` setting as of Rust 1.99.

| Setting | Default | Lints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`absolute-paths-allowed-crates`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#absolute-paths-allowed-crates) | `[]` | `absolute_paths` | Which crates to allow absolute paths from |
| [`absolute-paths-max-segments`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#absolute-paths-max-segments) | `2` | `absolute_paths` | The maximum number of segments a path can have before being linted, anything above this will be linted. |
| [`accept-comment-above-attributes`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#accept-comment-above-attributes) | `true` | `undocumented_unsafe_blocks` | Whether to accept a safety comment to be placed above the attributes for the `unsafe` block |
| [`accept-comment-above-statement`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#accept-comment-above-statement) | `true` | `undocumented_unsafe_blocks` | Whether to accept a safety comment to be placed above the statement containing the `unsafe` block |
| [`allow-comparison-to-zero`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-comparison-to-zero) | `true` | `modulo_arithmetic` | Don't lint when comparing the result of a modulo operation to zero. |
| [`allow-dbg-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-dbg-in-tests) | `false` | `dbg_macro` | Whether `dbg!` should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-exact-repetitions`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-exact-repetitions) | `true` | `module_name_repetitions` | Whether an item should be allowed to have the same name as its containing module |
| [`allow-expect-in-consts`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-expect-in-consts) | `true` | `expect_used` | Whether `expect` should be allowed in code always evaluated at compile time |
| [`allow-expect-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-expect-in-tests) | `false` | `expect_used` | Whether `expect` should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-indexing-slicing-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-indexing-slicing-in-tests) | `false` | `indexing_slicing` | Whether `indexing_slicing` should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-large-stack-frames-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-large-stack-frames-in-tests) | `true` | `large_stack_frames` | Whether functions inside `#[cfg(test)]` modules or test functions should be checked. |
| [`allow-mixed-uninlined-format-args`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-mixed-uninlined-format-args) | `true` | `uninlined_format_args` | Whether to allow mixed uninlined format args, e.g. `format!("{} {}", a, foo.bar)` |
| [`allow-one-hash-in-raw-strings`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-one-hash-in-raw-strings) | `false` | `needless_raw_string_hashes` | Whether to allow `r#""#` when `r""` can be used |
| [`allow-panic-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-panic-in-tests) | `false` | `panic` | Whether `panic` should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-print-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-print-in-tests) | `false` | `print_stderr`, `print_stdout` | Whether print macros (ex. `println!`) should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-private-module-inception`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-private-module-inception) | `false` | `module_inception` | Whether to allow module inception if it's not public. |
| [`allow-renamed-params-for`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-renamed-params-for) | `["core::convert::From", "core::convert::TryFrom", "core::str::FromStr"]` | `renamed_function_params` | List of trait paths to ignore when checking renamed function parameters. |
| [`allow-unwrap-in-consts`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-unwrap-in-consts) | `true` | `unwrap_used` | Whether `unwrap` should be allowed in code always evaluated at compile time |
| [`allow-unwrap-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-unwrap-in-tests) | `false` | `unwrap_used` | Whether `unwrap` should be allowed in test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allow-unwrap-types`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-unwrap-types) | `[]` | `expect_used`, `unwrap_used` | List of types to allow `unwrap()` and `expect()` on. |
| [`allow-useless-vec-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allow-useless-vec-in-tests) | `false` | `useless_vec` | Whether `useless_vec` should ignore test functions or `#[cfg(test)]` |
| [`allowed-dotfiles`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-dotfiles) | `[]` | `path_ends_with_ext` | Additional dotfiles (files or directories starting with a dot) to allow |
| [`allowed-duplicate-crates`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-duplicate-crates) | `[]` | `multiple_crate_versions` | A list of crate names to allow duplicates of |
| [`allowed-idents-below-min-chars`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-idents-below-min-chars) | `["i", "j", "x", "y", "z", "w", "n"]` | `min_ident_chars` | Allowed names below the minimum allowed characters. The value `".."` can be used as part of the list to indicate that the configured values should be appended to the default configuration of Clippy. By default, any configuration will replace the default value. |
| [`allowed-prefixes`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-prefixes) | `["to", "as", "into", "from", "try_into", "try_from"]` | `module_name_repetitions` | List of prefixes to allow when determining whether an item's name ends with the module's name. If the rest of an item's name is an allowed prefix (e.g. item `ToFoo` or `to_foo` in module `foo`), then don't emit a warning. |
| [`allowed-scripts`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-scripts) | `["Latin"]` | `disallowed_script_idents` | The list of unicode scripts allowed to be used in the scope. |
| [`allowed-wildcard-imports`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#allowed-wildcard-imports) | `[]` | `wildcard_imports` | List of path segments allowed to have wildcard imports. |
| [`arithmetic-side-effects-allowed`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#arithmetic-side-effects-allowed) | `[]` | `arithmetic_side_effects` | Suppress checking of the passed type names in all types of operations. |
| [`arithmetic-side-effects-allowed-binary`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#arithmetic-side-effects-allowed-binary) | `[]` | `arithmetic_side_effects` | Suppress checking of the passed type pair names in binary operations like addition or multiplication. |
| [`arithmetic-side-effects-allowed-unary`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#arithmetic-side-effects-allowed-unary) | `[]` | `arithmetic_side_effects` | Suppress checking of the passed type names in unary operations like "negation" (`-`). |
| [`array-size-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#array-size-threshold) | `16384` | `large_const_arrays`, `large_stack_arrays` | The maximum allowed size for arrays on the stack |
| [`avoid-breaking-exported-api`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#avoid-breaking-exported-api) | `true` | `box_collection`, `enum_variant_names`, `large_types_passed_by_value`, `linkedlist`, `needless_pass_by_ref_mut`, `option_option`, `owned_cow`, `rc_buffer`, `rc_mutex`, `redundant_allocation`, `ref_option`, `single_call_fn`, `trivially_copy_pass_by_ref`, `unnecessary_box_returns`, `unnecessary_wraps`, `unused_self`, `upper_case_acronyms`, `vec_box`, `wrong_self_convention` | Suppress lints whenever the suggested change would cause breakage for other crates. |
| [`await-holding-invalid-types`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#await-holding-invalid-types) | `[]` | `await_holding_invalid_type` | The list of types which may not be held across an await point. |
| [`cargo-ignore-publish`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#cargo-ignore-publish) | `false` | `cargo_common_metadata` | For internal testing only, ignores the current `publish` settings in the Cargo manifest. |
| [`check-grouped-late-init`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#check-grouped-late-init) | `true` | `needless_late_init` | Whether to check for grouped late initializations from multiple `let` statements. |
| [`check-incompatible-msrv-in-tests`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#check-incompatible-msrv-in-tests) | `false` | `incompatible_msrv` | Whether to check MSRV compatibility in `#[test]` and `#[cfg(test)]` code. |
| [`check-inconsistent-struct-field-initializers`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#check-inconsistent-struct-field-initializers) | `false` | `inconsistent_struct_constructor` | Whether to suggest reordering constructor fields when initializers are present. |
| [`check-private-items`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#check-private-items) | `false` | `missing_errors_doc`, `missing_panics_doc`, `missing_safety_doc`, `unnecessary_safety_doc` | Whether to also run the listed lints on private items. |
| [`cognitive-complexity-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#cognitive-complexity-threshold) | `25` | `cognitive_complexity` | The maximum cognitive complexity a function can have |
| [`const-literal-digits-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#const-literal-digits-threshold) | `30` | `excessive_precision` | The minimum digits a const float literal must have to supress the `excessive_precicion` lint |
| [`disallowed-fields`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#disallowed-fields) | `[]` | `disallowed_fields` | The list of disallowed fields, written as fully qualified paths. |
| [`disallowed-macros`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#disallowed-macros) | `[]` | `disallowed_macros` | The list of disallowed macros, written as fully qualified paths. |
| [`disallowed-methods`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#disallowed-methods) | `[]` | `disallowed_methods` | The list of disallowed methods, written as fully qualified paths. |
| [`disallowed-names`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#disallowed-names) | `["foo", "baz", "quux"]` | `disallowed_names` | The list of disallowed names to lint about. NB: `bar` is not here since it has legitimate uses. The value `".."` can be used as part of the list to indicate that the configured values should be appended to the default configuration of Clippy. By default, any configuration will replace the default value. |
| [`disallowed-types`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#disallowed-types) | `[]` | `disallowed_types` | The list of disallowed types, written as fully qualified paths. |
| [`doc-valid-idents`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#doc-valid-idents) | `["KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB", "EiB", "MHz", "GHz", "THz", "AccessKit", "CoAP", "CoreFoundation", "CoreGraphics", "CoreText", "DevOps", "Direct2D", "Direct3D", "DirectWrite", "DirectX", "ECMAScript", "GPLv2", "GPLv3", "GitHub", "GitLab", "IPv4", "IPv6", "InfiniBand", "RoCE", "ClojureScript", "CoffeeScript", "JavaScript", "PostScript", "PureScript", "TypeScript", "PowerPC", "PowerShell", "WebAssembly", "NaN", "NaNs", "OAuth", "GraphQL", "SQLite", "MySQL", "PostgreSQL", "MariaDB", "MongoDB", "OCaml", "OpenAL", "OpenDNS", "OpenGL", "OpenMP", "OpenSSH", "OpenSSL", "OpenStreetMap", "OpenTelemetry", "OpenType", "WebGL", "WebGL2", "WebGPU", "WebRTC", "WebSocket", "WebTransport", "WebP", "OpenExr", "YCbCr", "sRGB", "TensorFlow", "TrueType", "iOS", "macOS", "FreeBSD", "NetBSD", "OpenBSD", "NixOS", "TeX", "LaTeX", "BibTeX", "BibLaTeX", "MinGW", "CamelCase"]` | `doc_markdown` | The list of words this lint should not consider as identifiers needing ticks. The value `".."` can be used as part of the list to indicate that the configured values should be appended to the default configuration of Clippy. By default, any configuration will replace the default value. For example: * `doc-valid-idents = ["ClipPy"]` would replace the default list with `["ClipPy"]`. * `doc-valid-idents = ["ClipPy", ".."]` would append `ClipPy` to the default list. |
| [`enable-raw-pointer-heuristic-for-send`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#enable-raw-pointer-heuristic-for-send) | `true` | `non_send_fields_in_send_ty` | Whether to apply the raw pointer heuristic to determine if a type is `Send`. |
| [`enforce-iter-loop-reborrow`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#enforce-iter-loop-reborrow) | `false` | `explicit_iter_loop` | Whether to recommend using implicit into iter for reborrowed values. |
| [`enforced-import-renames`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#enforced-import-renames) | `[]` | `missing_enforced_import_renames` | The list of imports to always rename, a fully qualified path followed by the rename. |
| [`enum-variant-name-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#enum-variant-name-threshold) | `3` | `enum_variant_names` | The minimum number of enum variants for the lints about variant names to trigger |
| [`enum-variant-size-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#enum-variant-size-threshold) | `200` | `large_enum_variant` | The maximum size of an enum's variant to avoid box suggestion |
| [`excessive-nesting-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#excessive-nesting-threshold) | `0` | `excessive_nesting` | The maximum amount of nesting a block can reside in |
| [`future-size-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#future-size-threshold) | `16384` | `large_futures` | The maximum byte size a `Future` can have, before it triggers the `clippy::large_futures` lint |
| [`ignore-interior-mutability`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#ignore-interior-mutability) | `["bytes::Bytes"]` | `borrow_interior_mutable_const`, `declare_interior_mutable_const`, `ifs_same_cond`, `mutable_key_type` | A list of paths to types that should be treated as if they do not contain interior mutability |
| [`inherent-impl-lint-scope`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#inherent-impl-lint-scope) | `"crate"` | `multiple_inherent_impl` | Sets the scope ("crate", "file", or "module") in which duplicate inherent `impl` blocks for the same type are linted. |
| [`large-error-ignored`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#large-error-ignored) | `[]` | `result_large_err` | A list of paths to types that should be ignored as overly large `Err`-variants in a `Result` returned from a function |
| [`large-error-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#large-error-threshold) | `128` | `result_large_err` | The maximum size of the `Err`-variant in a `Result` returned from a function |
| [`lint-commented-code`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#lint-commented-code) | `false` | `collapsible_else_if`, `collapsible_if` | Whether collapsible `if` and `else if` chains are linted if they contain comments inside the parts that would be collapsed. |
| [`literal-representation-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#literal-representation-threshold) | `16384` | `decimal_literal_representation` | The lower bound for linting decimal literals |
| [`matches-for-let-else`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#matches-for-let-else) | `"WellKnownTypes"` | `manual_let_else` | Whether the matches should be considered by the lint, and whether there should be filtering for common types. |
| [`max-fn-params-bools`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#max-fn-params-bools) | `3` | `fn_params_excessive_bools` | The maximum number of bool parameters a function can have. Use `0` to lint on any function with a bool parameter. |
| [`max-include-file-size`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#max-include-file-size) | `1000000` | `large_include_file` | The maximum size of a file included via `include_bytes!()` or `include_str!()`, in bytes |
| [`max-struct-bools`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#max-struct-bools) | `3` | `struct_excessive_bools` | The maximum number of bool fields a struct can have |
| [`max-suggested-slice-pattern-length`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#max-suggested-slice-pattern-length) | `3` | `index_refutable_slice` | When Clippy suggests using a slice pattern, this is the maximum number of elements allowed in the slice pattern that is suggested. If more elements are necessary, the lint is suppressed. For example, `[_, _, _, e, ..]` is a slice pattern with 4 elements. |
| [`max-trait-bounds`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#max-trait-bounds) | `3` | `type_repetition_in_bounds` | The maximum number of bounds a trait can have to be linted |
| [`min-ident-chars-lint-trait-impl`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#min-ident-chars-lint-trait-impl) | `false` | `min_ident_chars` | Whether to lint idents that have too few chars even when following trait declaration. |
| [`min-ident-chars-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#min-ident-chars-threshold) | `1` | `min_ident_chars` | Minimum chars an ident can have, anything below or equal to this will be linted. |
| [`missing-docs-allow-unused`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#missing-docs-allow-unused) | `false` | `missing_docs_in_private_items` | Whether to allow fields starting with an underscore to skip documentation requirements |
| [`missing-docs-in-crate-items`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#missing-docs-in-crate-items) | `false` | `missing_docs_in_private_items` | Whether to **only** check for missing documentation in items visible within the current crate. For example, `pub(crate)` items. |
| [`module-item-order-groupings`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#module-item-order-groupings) | `[["modules", ["extern_crate", "mod", "foreign_mod"]], ["use", ["use"]], ["macros", ["macro"]], ["global_asm", ["global_asm"]], ["UPPER_SNAKE_CASE", ["static", "const"]], ["PascalCase", ["ty_alias", "enum", "struct", "union", "trait", "trait_alias", "impl"]], ["lower_snake_case", ["fn"]]]` | `arbitrary_source_item_ordering` | The named groupings of different source item kinds within modules. |
| [`module-items-ordered-within-groupings`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#module-items-ordered-within-groupings) | `"none"` | `arbitrary_source_item_ordering` | Whether the items within module groups should be ordered alphabetically or not. |

| [`pub-underscore-fields-behavior`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#pub-underscore-fields-behavior) | `"PubliclyExported"` | `pub_underscore_fields` | Lint "public" fields in a struct that are prefixed with an underscore based on their exported visibility, or whether they are marked as "pub". |

| [`too-many-lines-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#too-many-lines-threshold) | `100` | `too_many_lines` | The maximum number of lines a function or method can have |
| [`trait-assoc-item-kinds-order`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#trait-assoc-item-kinds-order) | `["const", "type", "fn"]` | `arbitrary_source_item_ordering` | The order of associated items in traits. |
| [`trait-impl-item-order`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#trait-impl-item-order) | `"alphabetical"` | `arbitrary_source_item_ordering` | The required ordering of associated items in trait impls: purely alphabetical, following the trait definition order, or accepting either. |
| [`trivial-copy-size-limit`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#trivial-copy-size-limit) | `target_pointer_width` | `trivially_copy_pass_by_ref` | The maximum size (in bytes) to consider a `Copy` type for passing by value instead of by reference. |
| [`type-complexity-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#type-complexity-threshold) | `250` | `type_complexity` | The maximum complexity a type can have |
| [`unnecessary-box-size`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#unnecessary-box-size) | `128` | `unnecessary_box_returns` | The byte size a `T` in `Box<T>` can have, below which it triggers the `clippy::unnecessary_box` lint |
| [`unreadable-literal-lint-fractions`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#unreadable-literal-lint-fractions) | `true` | `unreadable_literal` | Should the fraction of a decimal be linted to include separators. |
| [`upper-case-acronyms-aggressive`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#upper-case-acronyms-aggressive) | `false` | `upper_case_acronyms` | Enables verbose mode. Triggers if there is more than one uppercase char next to each other |
| [`vec-box-size-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#vec-box-size-threshold) | `4096` | `vec_box` | The size of the boxed type in bytes, where boxing in a `Vec` is allowed |
| [`verbose-bit-mask-threshold`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#verbose-bit-mask-threshold) | `1` | `verbose_bit_mask` | The maximum allowed size of a bit mask before suggesting to use 'trailing_zeros' |
| [`warn-on-all-wildcard-imports`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#warn-on-all-wildcard-imports) | `false` | `wildcard_imports` | Whether to emit warnings on all wildcard imports, including those from `prelude`, from `super` in tests, or for `pub use` reexports. |
| [`warn-unsafe-macro-metavars-in-private-macros`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/clippy/lint_configuration.html#warn-unsafe-macro-metavars-in-private-macros) | `false` | `macro_metavars_in_unsafe` | Whether to also emit warnings for unsafe blocks with metavariable expansions in **private** macros. |
